name: PuntoWoo Mobile App & Loyalty Wallet API
author: NovekDev

sections.description:
PuntoWoo Mobile App & Loyalty Wallet API connects your WooCommerce store and the PuntoWoo Loyalty Wallet for WooCommerce plugin to the PuntoWoo Digital Wallet Android and iOS mobile app.

Allow your customers to carry their digital membership card directly on their phones, check real-time loyalty points and gift card cash balances, upload profile selfies, and scan Code 128 barcodes at physical retail checkout counters.

📲 Official Android App Download

The companion mobile app is ready to install! Download the official Android APK:
👉 Download PuntoWoo Digital Wallet APK

🌟 Key Features

  • Store Discovery REST API: Public endpoint (/wp-json/loyalty-app/v1/store/config) enabling the mobile app to automatically detect store name, logo, currency, points exchange rate, and branding colors.
  • Token-Based Mobile Authentication: Safe Bearer token session authentication allowing customers to log in using their existing WooCommerce account email and password.
  • Real-Time Loyalty Wallet Sync: Synchronizes 10-digit digital card numbers, live points balance, and gift card store credit with zero database bloat.
  • Customer Profile & Photo Uploader: Mobile camera and gallery photo upload endpoint with automatic avatar integration.
  • Transaction History Ledger: Real-time chronological audit trail of orders, points earned, points redeemed, and wallet balance adjustments.
  • Printable In-Store QR Stand Flyer: Generates high-resolution vector QR counter flyers from wp-admin to help physical store customers download and connect the app in seconds.
  • Customer My Account App Widget: Configurable onboarding card and direct APK / Google Play download buttons inside the WooCommerce My Account area.
  • HPOS & WooCommerce Blocks Compatible: Fully declared and tested with High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables) and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the puntowoo-mobile-app-loyalty-wallet-api folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP through the WordPress admin (Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Lealtad > 📱 Mobile App to configure download links, generate printable counter flyers, and test your REST API endpoints.
  4. Download and distribute the companion mobile app APK: Download PuntoWoo Digital Wallet APK.
  5. Your endpoints are immediately accessible at /wp-json/loyalty-app/v1/.
sections.faq:
Does this require the PuntoWoo Loyalty core plugin?

Yes. This extension works alongside the PuntoWoo Loyalty & Digital Wallet for WooCommerce plugin to synchronize points, barcodes, and wallet balances.

Does this modify my database structure?

No. This extension reads existing user metadata non-destructively and introduces zero core schema alterations or database bloat.

Where can customers download the companion mobile app?

Customers can download the Android APK directly from: Download PuntoWoo Digital Wallet APK. Store owners can also configure custom download URLs or Google Play links under Lealtad > 📱 Mobile App, which automatically adds direct download buttons to the customer’s My Account page.

Is High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) supported?

Yes, HPOS (Custom Order Tables) and Block Checkout compatibility are declared and verified.
